sentences.prototype: Done when the code passes its own tests; the product is not started or checked against your acceptance tests.
sentences.light: The finished product is started and checked against your acceptance tests; code that is mostly Factory templates still passes; the security scan is advice only.
sentences.pilot: The finished product is started and checked against your acceptance tests; code that is mostly Factory templates fails it; the security scan is advice only.
sentences.production: The finished product is started and checked against your acceptance tests; code that is mostly Factory templates fails it; every check must pass, the security scan included.
